groups.definition: Risk that acquisitions, joint ventures or investments fail to integrate employees, R&D and systems or deliver expected benefits.
Risk that incurring additional indebtedness increases leverage and constrains financial flexibility.
Risk that significant goodwill and acquired intangibles become impaired, causing large non-cash charges to earnings.
Risk that failures or disruptions of information technology systems impair operations.
Risk that limited control over joint ventures or minority stakes leads to misconduct, control failures, penalties and reputational harm.
Risk that restructuring actions incur higher costs or fail to achieve intended savings.
Risk that share repurchases are reduced, suspended or vary in amount and timing.
Risk that acquisitions, divestitures, capital investments and restructuring fail to deliver expected strategic results.
